affected_system: cross-agency public-service access, workload, quality, and outcome distribution
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased cross-agency service-equity intervention
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased cross-agency service-equity intervention
pair staggered service-area evaluation with need and outcome panels with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Need, eligibility, access, requests, service, quality, and outcomes remain separate measures.
Protected and vulnerable group reporting follows privacy, legal, and small-cell safeguards.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased cross-agency service-equity intervention.

constraints.description: The distributional public-service equity evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief equity officer and city performance director
decision_question: Did phased access and capacity interventions reduce verified need-adjusted disparities without displacement?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The distributional public-service equity evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased cross-agency service-equity intervention passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: staggered service-area evaluation with need and outcome panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in need-adjusted service access and outcome gaps

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased cross-agency service-equity intervention, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in need-adjusted service access and outcome gaps
distributional gap in change in need-adjusted service access and outcome gaps
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer discrimination reduction, welfare, or causal equity from area-level requests alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased cross-agency service-equity intervention passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate service-equity interventions
transportability_risks: Rights, demographics, service rules, need measurement, geography, and reporting access differ.
Administrative denominators may omit eligible or underserved populations.
